verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS risk-management platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to. The ML risk scoring (adyen-risk-docs-5, adyen-risk-docs-20) is automated fraud evaluation, not a task-delegation assistant. The MCP server (adyen-risk-docs-17) lets you use your own external LLM client, which is not a built-in assistant.
